evaluation_plan.success: Every graph node and required contact; relative geometry; uprightness; load equilibrium using 2 mm eroded contact patches; robot withdrawal; five seconds within 3 mm drift.
evaluation_plan.scope: Upright cubes, prism and cylinder in three low-rise recipes; no horizontal long-beam reorientation, arbitrary graph or real-world claim. Sensor-only CPU policy; GPU simulation/rendering allowed.
evaluation_plan.reporting: Preserve all failures, controlled stops and worker errors. No source tuning on held-out results.

reporting: Every declared trial, including failures. Small recipe-specific cells with repeated seeds; not arbitrary-structure generalization.
runtime_boundary: CPU visual policy; no simulator object truth or evaluator feedback is available online.
offline_evaluation: Private final checks below are offline labels using simulator geometry, contacts and velocities.
